notes.title: About the UE5/PSO 2 update
notes.notes:
This is not the finish line for PSO 2, it's the start line.

I understand that the UE5 update is lacking gameplay and functionality wise and needs lots of fixes and tweaks. We are aware and are going to be working on improving it as much as possible. In a few weeks the game could be in a better state than the UE4 version of the game. There will be at least 1 update a week if not 2 for the coming months, so please don't give up hope yet.

This is also why the UE4 version of the game is still available with Steam beta branches until the end of August.



To play the UE4 version of the game follow these steps:

1. Right click on PSO in your Steam library

2. Click properties

3, Click on betas tab

4. Click the beta participation selection box

5. Click ue4_pso and then it should start to download

notes.title: UE5/PSO 2 Update!!!
notes.notes:
Ladies and gentleman the time has finally come for the UE5/PSO 2 update to be released. It's been worked on for just over 1.5 years and it's finally ready. Featuring a new game engine and lots of extra features, it should bring PSO back to life.

New game engine (Unreal Engine 5)

Better anti-cheat

Ranked modes

Detailed player and team profiles

Better customization

Gameplay tweaks

The update has been improving consistently for the past few months and while this version of the game is not quite perfect yet, it's in a solid state and worth releasing at this point. This way people can play and enjoy it, and we can also start getting a wider variety of feedback on what to improve and fix.



Gameplay may need more tweaking to get it feeling just right, and we will be working on it over the next few weeks. There's already lots more customization items that have yet to be added into the game and will be added over the following weeks as well. There's also 2D stadium crowds that are almost ready and will be added in the next few weeks too.



The Unreal Engine 4 version of the game is still playable using Steam beta branches. The beta branch is named "ue4_pso". This will be playable until the end of August at which point it will be shut down permanently.

notes.title: Beta 1.1.31 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixed fouls counting in warmup and far away from the ball.
Reduced acceleration changes.
Reduced slide tackle and bicycle kick hitbox size.

notes.title: Beta 1.1.21 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Removed ball impulse when hitting a player. This ended up being buggy.
Increased gk catch/defelection threshold speed.
Slightly reduced throw in power.
Slightly increased head hitbox size.
Fixed bug related to gk dive catching a ball outside the box, and having high acceleration afterwards.

notes.title: RELEASE DAY!!!
notes.notes: After months of testing, Pro Soccer Online is launching into Early Access on Steam. Thank you to everyone who helped with testing, donations and sharing with others. It wouldn't be where it is without you. You guys da real MVP. Be sure to share with friends and social media. Some of the next few steps in development will be getting translations added, improving matchmaking and fixing any bugs. After that it will shift towards a possible graphics overhaul, general improvements, lots more customization items with microtransactions, and possibly transition to free 2 play. After that, the focus will be game modes such as MyTeam and maybe others. Enjoy the game :)
